title: Omnipod Eros fails comm after 1d
symptom: Since moving to AAPS 3.2.0.4, Omnipod Eros pods fail communication earlier than 3 days. When trying to deliver insulin or change temp basal, the message 'communication failed: nonce resume failed' appears.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. Possible explanations discussed include excessive communication draining pod battery, low pod battery voltage, faulty pods, or local setup issues, but none are confirmed.
fix: No fix is confirmed. Suggestions include switching the RL device off/on, restarting the phone, removing and re-registering the RL, and reverting to an older AAPS version, but the user reports these did not resolve the issue.
evidence_quote: I tried everything you mentioned for every pod that failed and nothing changed. Also, this issue didn't appear with the previous version of AAPS, 2.8.
